text:
maria: Draft for the internal announce is up for a quick copy pass. EU change window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need pin target + rollback owner. @ajay can you take rollback? :eyes:

ajay: I can own rollback. Need exact commit + which pin target (v3.2.1 vs v3.3-rc). Also will we do a full pin or staged pin?

maria: We'll pin to v3.2.1 (stable). Commit: 0a1b2c3d. Here's the current release snippet for internal notes — quick read and small wording nits pls:

```
- Performance: Improved token batching to reduce tail-latency (~15% median).
- Fix: Gateway retries causing duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: restart sidecar).
- Note: Canary users may see transient 502s during early rollout. Rollback plan in thread.
```

sophie: Quick suggestion: change 'restart sidecar' -> 'recycle sidecar pod' so it's clear for k8s teams. Also change 'Canary users' -> 'Canary cohort'.

leo: Agree with sophie. Also add an explicit rollback bullet with owner + command, e.g. 'Rollback: pin back to v3.2.0 using deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 (Ajay)'.

ajay: I'll be rollback owner. My steps: `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 regressions"` then monitor traffic/latency for 10m. Don't run until ops-oncall gives the goto.

katie: Copy tweak: 'Canary users' -> 'Canary cohort' and rephrase 'transient 502s' -> 'transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests'. Otherwise :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — will update. We also need deploy schedule: target 02:15 UTC (canary start). @deploybot please schedule the canary and post cues. Quiet window + notify oncall at 10m mark.

deploybot: Scheduled: canary deploy for v3.2.1 at 2025-06-18T02:15:00Z (UTC). Canary window 20m. Notification: will ping @ops-oncall at the 10m gate. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/release-runbooks/v3.2.1

ops-oncall: I'll monitor canary. Trigger criteria: if 502 rate > 1% sustained for 5m or error spike >2x baseline, I'll ask Ajay to roll back. Ajay: hold the rollback command until I confirm.

ajay: Copy that — standing by. Also confirm we will set model-serving pin policy to 'allowlist' for the rollout and pin commit 0a1b2c3d in orchestrator.

sophie: One more legal/PR ask — they want explicit 'No API changes' line so customers aren't confused. Can we add that?

maria: Added: 'No API changes; behavior updates are limited to performance and telemetry.'

leo: Final draft below. If no objections within 30m I'll pin this and queue the internal announce.

```
Internal release notes (v3.2.1 - internal draft):
- Performance: Improved token batching to reduce tail-latency (~15% median).
- Fix: Gateway retries causing duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may observe transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests. Ops will monitor; rollback owner: Ajay.
- Rollback: Pin back to v3.2.0 via `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 regressions"` (Ajay).
- Customer impact: No API changes; behavior updates limited to performance and telemetry.
```

maria: If you 👍 here I'll push the pin and prep the internal blast. Ops-oncall, confirm you'll watch the 10m gate?

ops-oncall: Confirmed. I'll give a green if metrics look steady at 10m, or call for rollback otherwise.

maria: Thanks team — locking copy in 25m unless someone flags. :lock:
